submitted.rationale: Out of 5 EQE measurements (Sb fractions 0.082, 0.117, 0.308, 0.478, 0.618), only index 0 (Sb 0.082, the La-rich end of the line) gave a clearly nonzero photoresponse, 0.0153%. Every other sample was about 0 (≤0.0002%). The known La antimonates (La3SbO7 and LaSbO4) are predicted to have band gaps of about 4.3 eV, too wide to absorb 2.7 eV photons. La3Sb5O12 has a predicted gap of 2.26 eV, but its composition (index 25) gave no EQE and its XRD did not match that phase. The XRD at index 5 did not match any known La–Sb–O phase either.
